notes.title: Weekend Sale: Huge Discounts on Rabbiman Adventures
notes.content:
Want to try Rabbiman Adventures? Good news!  

For this weekend only, we've dropped the price. You can snag the base game for just $11.99 – that's a solid discount from the usual $19.99.  And if you're looking for extra goodies, the Welcome Pack is also on sale for only $1.99 (regularly $3.99).

This is your chance to explore all the hidden corners of Rabbiman's world, tackle new challenges, and enjoy everything the game has to offer at a much sweeter price.  This special offer is only around for a short time though – just three days – so don't wait too long!

Curious to see what awaits you?  Check out our store page for screenshots and a full rundown of what's included in both the game and the Welcome Pack.  Plus, remember you're buying with Steam's refund policy in place, so you can purchase with peace of mind.

Don't miss out on this chance to grab Rabbiman Adventures and the Welcome Pack at these discounted prices.  Weekend fun, incoming!

notes.title: 🍄 Hats Off to Style: Rabbiman’s coolest DLC Yet
notes.content:
Rabbiman Adventures just got a little more fashionable—and a lot more fun! 

Our new DLC is here to help you stand out in the magical forest (or at least give the creatures something to talk about).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210996/f532d9372d6d97ad5769d515113aa672cd58515a.jpg

From the Dessert Hat (because who doesn’t want to look delicious?) to the UFO Hat (aliens called—they want their drip back), there’s something for every adventurer. Pair it with Gold Glasses for that “I’m-rich-and-I-know-it” vibe or go cosmic with the Cosmo Glasses for a look that’s truly out of this world.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210996/1ede18efe4dc25f0304bf807bb0d01e36ac5d2e3.png

Why settle for ordinary when you can be extraordinary? Whether you’re solving puzzles, dodging traps, or just strolling through the adventure, these accessories will make sure you do it in style.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210996/77e7c02b75373d53a849e389ed9e84df1628cb22.png

So, what are you waiting for? Grab the DLC, pick your favorite look, and let the allies and villains know: Rabbiman’s got style.

P.S. No, the Chicken Hat doesn’t make you fly. We checked. 🐔✨

notes.title: Dev Live Stream 4pm CET
notes.content:
Event Announcement: Rabbiman Adventures Live Stream!

Hey everyone! 🎉 
We’ve got something special for you this week. Join us for a 2-hour live stream where one of our team members will be playing Rabbiman Adventures like a pro!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210996/3a0092ca305512f3e4dea2fe59cae703377ab3dc.jpg

What to expect:

🎮 Gameplay showcase: Watch as we explore magical forests, solve puzzles, and uncover hidden secrets.

🐰 Pro tips & tricks: Learn how to master the hat mechanics and ace those platforming sections.

💬 Live Q&A: Got questions about the game? We’ll be answering them live!

🕹️ Classic platformer vibes: Relive the charm of retro platformers with a modern twist.

When: 4pm CET

Where: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3226680/Rabbiman_Adventures/

Whether you’re a longtime fan or new to Rabbiman Adventures, this stream is for you. Grab some snacks, sit back, and let’s dive into the magic together. See you there!

notes.title: Rabbiman Adventures is out!
notes.content:
Rabbiman Adventures is Finally Here – and It’s Bigger Than Ever! From Demo to the Full Release.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210996/1d62413509f8611149f5dad6d9b47cc558735ca7.jpg

Hey everyone, the moment you’ve been waiting for is here: Rabbiman Adventures is officially out! 🎉 This isn’t just another puzzle game – it’s a cool, whimsical journey through magical forests, mind-bending puzzles, and a world full of surprises. And guess what? We’ve got something extra special for you: a brand-new DLC packed with hats and glasses to customize your hero in style.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210996/54cac0f9f6d0db443ed029226c454b9d8f50f248.png

🎩A Hat That Does It All: This isn’t just any hat. It’s your ultimate tool for teleporting, solving puzzles, and unlocking new areas. The more you play, the more tricks you’ll discover.

🥸New DLC – Hats & Glasses Galore: Want to make your hero stand out? Our new DLC lets you deck them out in the coolest hats and glasses. From funky fedoras to sleek shades, there’s something for every style.

🧩Puzzles That Keep You Hooked: Whether you’re a casual player or a puzzle pro, there’s something here for you. The main levels are just the beginning – the extra challenges will push your skills to the limit.

🎵A Soundtrack That Slaps: The music is a mix of old-school hip-hop beats, scratches, and original loops that perfectly match the game’s vibe. It’s not just background noise – it’s part of the adventure.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210996/31c6dbc9430733582f50016f2684954b2112858e.jpg

Let us know what you think! Share your favorite moments, your best puzzle solves, and your hero’s new look. We can’t wait to see how far you’ll go in this magical world.
